limitations: Every tracked file was enumerated and hashed and readable text opened
Python AST parsed, JavaScript/typescript is text/static only; not full TypeScript AST or full dataflow
No semantic execution or proof of production integrations by this index
Does not include untracked/private files, branch history, remote deployed services or unmounted artifacts
An inventory of the BASE COMMIT; edit wave source files added later are deliberately not part of baseline
A file being parseable does not mean its implementation is correct or connected
Runtime, Blender, Godot, hosted auth and user acceptance still require separate proof
